about_the_game:
Overview

"Embrace the Brilliance" is a game about setting gemstones to craft jewelry. Expertly arrange diamonds, rubies, sapphires, emeralds, and more to create beautiful pieces. From simple rings and pendants to majestic crowns, a wide variety of jewelry awaits!

Multiplayer

Supports multiplayer for up to 4 players! Join or leave at any time. Have friends jump into a solo project midway, or step out and rejoin later—total freedom. Enjoy both quiet solo time and lively sessions with everyone.

Simple Controls for Gemstone Setting

Controls are easy! Left-click to pick up a gemstone, drag it to the setting, then right-click to secure the stone. Follow the blueprint and set each gem with care.

Confirming the Results

Admire your finished jewelry from every angle. Your build time—and, in multiplayer, each player’s contribution—are recorded. Relax and take your time, or challenge yourself with Time Attack runs now and then.

Video Streaming Guidelines

We at THINK & FEEL welcome the posting and streaming of "Embrace the Brilliance" videos and hereby establish the following guidelines for video posting and streaming of the game.

Permission for Posting and Streaming

  • For posting and live streaming of gameplay, commentary, and review videos of "Embrace the Brilliance", no special permission is needed, regardless of whether you are an individual or a corporation. You are free to post and stream.

Content Requirements

  • When posting or streaming, please include "Embrace the Brilliance" in the title of the video or stream.

  • In the description, include a link to the Steam store page.

  • Use of the game's visuals and music is limited to within the video itself. Separate distribution of music or sale of images is prohibited.

About Monetization

  • Monetization of videos through the monetization features provided by video streaming sites is permitted.

Prohibited Actions

  • Posting or streaming content that violates laws, or content that is offensive to others is prohibited.

Disclaimer

  • THINK & FEEL is not responsible for the content of posted videos.

  • The guidelines are subject to change without notice. Please check the store page for the latest information.

We sincerely hope that you enjoy "Embrace the Brilliance" and share its charm with people around the world. We fully support your creative content creation.

THINK & FEEL
